scraped.scraped_description: FixMyBlock aims to cut through the jargon and empower residents. Find out everything your landlords should be doing to keep tower blocks safe — and what to do if they aren’t.

name: FixMyBlock
tagline: Tried and tested action guides for getting stuff fixed in your block
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
documented_limitations: coverage limited to England, Wales and Scotland (not Northern Ireland)
focused on tower block / social housing tenants only
failure_modes: content becomes outdated as housing law changes
governance_model: Project of Tower Blocks UK, created in collaboration with mySociety
curation_criteria: Guides cover legal entitlements and practical escalation steps for tower block tenants in UK social housing
contributor_governance: Managed by Tower Blocks UK and mySociety partnership
